title: Warranty Claim
description: The claim submitted to PACCAR after warranty work is done on an RO, asking to be reimbursed for the labor and parts that were covered.
x-sap-analogue: Debit memo / claims-management document against a factory receivable account
x-api-note: The RO-to-claim document chain (RO -> draft warranty claim (PRWS) -> submission) is confirmed to exist and now available on Fortellis at a high level, but no public field-level schema for the warranty claim object itself was found.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

haswarrpayflag_source_ro.description: The RO-level flag confirming part of the work is warranty pay, which is what triggers a claim
haswarrpayflag_source_ro.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Repair Order v3 PDF

repairordernumber_source_ro.description: Links the claim back to the specific repair order that generated the warranty work
repairordernumber_source_ro.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Repair Order v3 PDF

prws_draft_claim_reference.description: Confirms the document chain RO -> draft warranty claim (PRWS) -> submission, now available on Fortellis
prws_draft_claim_reference.x-source-title: CDK Global — Heavy Truck OEM page

stamped_signed_part_evidence_retained.description: PACCAR requires the physical, stamped/signed failed-part evidence to be retained to support the claim
stamped_signed_part_evidence_retained.x-source-title: Reddit r/partscounter — CDK Tracking Warranty Parts

warranty_parts_paytype_and_parts_on_the_.description: The specific warranty-pay part lines from the RO that are included in this claim

warranty_parts_paytype_and_parts_on_the_.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Repair Order v3 PDF

warranty_receivable_schedule_balance.description: The open/submitted claim total awaiting factory payment, tracked as its own accounting schedule
